title: Skill promotion invalidation/rebuild
root_cause: Skill Studio promotion atomically updates four projections but leaves semantic, cognitive, and graph dependents unchanged.
source_requirement: Publish the canonical revision, invalidate every dependent projection, rebuild cheap projections, and block stale expensive projections.
implementation_steps: Extend atomic promotion transaction with dependency invalidation.
Rebuild cheap semantic/catalog/package projections inside the transaction.
Mark expensive cognitive/graph projections stale until governed rebuild.
Rollback all transactional changes on failure.
focused_tests: Disposable promotion success, invalidation, rebuild, failure rollback, and stale-consumer tests.
affected_tests: Semantic/cognitive/graph, routing, catalog, generated artifact tests.
evidence_required: Before/after hashes, invalidation cone, rebuilt revisions, and rollback receipt.
rollback: Use the existing transaction journal to restore all pre-promotion bytes and statuses.
acceptance_criteria: Every dependent projection is rebuilt or explicitly stale before promotion commits.
No stale skill revision is routable.
